//AllowedHosts: Development only. Deployed stacks must list their own host names (for example eu.app.example.com;*.azurecontainerapps.io); the host refuses to start with '*' outside Development.

AzureAd.//TenantId: The app is registered AzureADMultipleOrgs, so the authority is /organizations. The tenant is whichever one the user signs in from, taken from the validated tid claim.
AzureAd.//ClientId: Set locally with: dotnet user-secrets set AzureAd:ClientId <guid> -p src/Mlcp.Web. Never commit it here.
AzureAd.//ClientCredentials: Sign-in credential (ADR-026). Azure: AzureAd__ClientCredentials__0__SourceType=KeyVault, __KeyVaultUrl, __KeyVaultCertificateName, __ManagedIdentityClientId. Development: user-secrets AzureAd:ClientCredentials:0:SourceType=ClientSecret and AzureAd:ClientCredentials:0:ClientSecret.
AzureAd.//UsageInsightsClientId: Client id of the separate 'MLCP Usage Insights' registration (ADR-015). Optional; Guide D's connect button appears only when it is set.

Mlcp.//Region: This stack's region code, as used in the global region directory (ADR-021).
Mlcp.//PublicBaseUrl: This stack's https origin. Emailed links are built from it, never from the request Host. Required outside Development.
Mlcp.//CustomerRbacTemplateUrl: Raw URL of the compiled (JSON) infra/customer-rbac template, for Guide B's Deploy to Azure button.

Regions.//DirectoryTableUri: https://<global account>.table.core.windows.net/TenantRegions. Required outside Development; Development uses an in-memory directory.
Regions.//Hosts: Region code -> regional host name, e.g. "eu": "eu.app.example.com".
Regions.//Names: Region code -> how the region is described, e.g. "eu": "the EU".

ConnectionStrings.//: Local values come from user-secrets or docker compose; production from Key Vault via Managed Identity (CLAUDE.md rule 4).
